PARALLEL_THRESHOLD = 1e-4


def slerp_tensor(a: Tensor, b: Tensor, t: float) -> Tensor:
    if a.shape != b.shape:
        raise ValueError(f"shape mismatch: {tuple(a.shape)} vs {tuple(b.shape)}")
    a32 = a.float().flatten()
    b32 = b.float().flatten()
    dot = float(torch.dot(a32, b32).item())
    if dot < 0.0:
        b32 = -b32
        dot = -dot
    norm_a = float(torch.linalg.vector_norm(a32).item())
    norm_b = float(torch.linalg.vector_norm(b32).item())
    if norm_a == 0.0 or norm_b == 0.0:
        return torch.lerp(a32, b32, t).reshape(a.shape).to(a.dtype)
    cosine = max(-1.0, min(1.0, dot / (norm_a * norm_b)))
